ParquetNeo.Compression.Zstd

ZSTD (RFC 8878) using the managed ZstdSharp.Port library. Register it with CodecRegistry.Default.AddZstd().

public sealed class ZstdCodec : ICodec, IDisposable

Remarks

Compression and decompression contexts are expensive to create and not thread safe, so each thread keeps its own; dispose the codec to release them.
